data.title: Vehicle registration appointment, 7 March 2026
data.summary: The district vehicle registration office (Zulassungsstelle, Kreis Beispielförde) confirmed your Saturday-service appointment to transfer a vehicle registration. It is on 7 March 2026 at 10:00, counter 2. The fee is about €37.60.
data.explanation: This confirms your appointment at the vehicle registration office for a vehicle re-registration (Umschreibung). Go to counter 2 at the Kreishaus on 7 March 2026 at 10:00. Bring both parts of the registration certificate (Zulassungsbescheinigung Teil I and II), the insurance confirmation number (eVB-Nummer), a SEPA direct debit mandate for the vehicle tax (Kfz-Steuer), and your ID card. Expect a fee of about €37.60. If you cannot attend, contact the office by phone or e-mail.
